page: UpCloud GPU-24xCPU-480GB-2xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-performance computing, machine learning, and data-intensive workloads. It features 24 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processors built on the x86_64 architecture, running at a base speed of 2.0 GHz. The CPU configuration includes 24 physical cores with single-thread execution and a shared allocation model under the KVM hypervisor. The processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate deep learning and matrix multiplication tasks.

The server's memory subsystem consists of 480.0 GB of RAM, providing a high resource density of 20.0 GB per core. In memory benchmarks, the system demonstrates strong performance, achieving a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 4086.55 GB/sec and a large block uncached write bandwidth of 110.72 GB/sec. For acceleration, the instance is equipped with two NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, delivering a combined 160 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. No local storage is bundled with this instance, meaning storage resources must be attached externally.

Performance benchmarks highlight top-tier capabilities in specific workloads. Single-threaded gzip compression reaches 35.53 GB/sec, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieves 355.23 GB/sec. The system also excels in low-latency operations, processing 66.13 million Redis SET operations per second. For artificial intelligence workloads, the hardware processes 10457.59 tokens per second for prompt processing and 366.07 tokens per second for text generation on a 135M parameter model. This profile makes the instance highly cost-efficient for large-scale AI model training, LLM inference, and complex scientific simulations where GPU acceleration and high memory capacity are critical.
